title: Honey and Clover
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Art-college students Takemoto, Mayama and Morita share an apartment complex in Tokyo and meet Hagu, a shy, gifted first-year who lives with her relative, Professor Hanamoto. Their circle grows to include potter Ayumi Yamada, who loves Mayama, while Mayama pursues Rika, an older widowed architect. The story follows love triangles, unrequited love, graduation, job hunting and the search for who they are.
life_message: Growing up means loving honestly even when love is not returned, and finding work and a self worth giving your life to.
